critical_code_review_comments: Fix in Admin.jsx is clean: splash state + setTimeout(600ms) runs independently of /auth/me axios call. Conditional rendering at lines 659-663 cleanly handles the 3 states (splash loading / login / dashboard). No regressions introduced.

Minor: the splash timer runs even when a valid cached session returns quickly (<600ms) - but harmless because `authed === true` short-circuits the splash branch (dashboard renders immediately as observed in test 5b at 469ms).
